## Contract review

Reviewed at 2026-10-27T01:57Z — PR #26385 (card #26295, `skills/objectstack-ui`), independent contract review at the ceiling tier, read-only, adversarial to the dispatch order, the claim and the dev's report. Inputs: the card body and its four comments (re-fetched over REST at 2026-10-27T01:49Z, the claim amendment 6431429399 included), audit Part A rows U1/U2/U4/U5 on #26184 comment 6425678185, the PR body / file list / diff over REST, the spec and the four skills files on `origin/main` (`2163e806`) and on the head via `git show`, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` on both, `.github/workflows/lint.yml` on `origin/main`, and the check-runs on the head.

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `17b18cdeabc2bbdd96321799c97bce8e3d5c7eeb`
Local-runs: probe — `wc -c` over `git show 17b18cde:PATH` and `git show 756220c4:PATH` blobs to recompute the ratchet's own measure, `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)` (script line 763, a pure function of the blob), for the five touched files and the package's `.md` set; nothing built, no gate re-run
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the sixth path of the diff: the gate the five rows price, read as one change with the files), skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md (claimed home of the cut print-status clause), skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md § Search Fields (claimed home of the cut related-record prescription and allowed-set paragraph), skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md and references/_index.md (untouched; read for references to the cut lines and the new section), packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, dataset.zod.ts, action.zod.ts, action-copy-template.ts, action-on-success-executor.ts, bulk-action.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts, validate-action-copy-templates.ts, validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts, packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useGroupedData.ts and ObjectGrid.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts, examples/app-crm/src/flows/convert-lead.flow.ts, .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, .claude/agents/os-dev.md, eslint.config.mjs

**Check-runs on `17b18cde`, read at 2026-10-27T01:52Z: 50 total — 34 success, 16 skipped, 0 failure, 0 in progress** (the 01:46Z reading had 12 in progress; the last four — Test Core 1/8, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates` — completed between 01:47Z and 01:52Z, and three aggregate runs appeared: `Test Core`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, all success). Lane mapping, corrected from the brief by reading `lint.yml` on `origin/main`: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test` and the gate itself (lines 5589–5590), `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority` (5582), `check:skill-docs` (5326) and `check:skill-refs` (5458) all run in **`Type Check · source gates`**; `check:skill-examples` runs in **`Type Check · consumer gates`** (6463). Both success. `Lint · ESLint` success (no `max-len` rule exists in `eslint.config.mjs`, so the long row-comment lines are not capped by anything). `Check Changeset` success with `skip-changeset`; the three claim/closing guards (`The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`) success. The skipped 16 are the UI / docs / opt-in lanes the path filter skips for a diff with no `ui/**` or `content/**`.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Every new sentence against the spec on `origin/main` — all true, two nits.**

- *Grouping* (`rules/list-views.md` § Grouping, new). "nests levels, outermost first" — `GroupingConfigSchema`'s contract: `groupBy = fields[].field` in nesting order (`view.zod.ts` ~1480). "A `select` level keeps its option order … others sort by label" — the console's comparator (`useGroupedData.ts` `compareGroupEntries`, 341–380) ranks group keys by the field's declared `options` when `ObjectGrid.tsx` (2466–2480) builds `groupOptionRanks` from `objectFields[field].options`, and falls back to label order when the field declares none; the dev's premise correction (pipeline order = `{ field: 'stage' }`, no `orderBy`) is right. "`orderBy` orders a level's groups by a number, date or boolean field of the same object — text or a select is refused (`list-view-group-order-unorderable`)" — the id is emitted by `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` `checkGroupOrder` (1022–1058): it judges `min` (asc) / `max` (desc) over the field's declared type through `AGGREGATE_FIELD_TYPE_COMPATIBILITY`, whose min/max row is the numeric class (`number`, `currency`, `percent`, `rating`, `slider`, `progress`, `summary`), the temporal class (`date`, `datetime`, `time`) and the boolean class (`boolean`, `toggle`); `text` and `select` are outside it, and `formula` is refused by the virtual-field remedy. `order: 'desc'` is a real key (`order: z.enum(['asc','desc']).default('asc')`, view.zod.ts 1437); `orderBy` at 1441. The example `{ field: 'period_label', orderBy: 'period_start', order: 'desc' }` is the spec's own fixture case. Right.
- *Duration* (`rules/dashboards.md` Computed-column bullet, Level A table, Leave-days bullet). `{ name, aggregate: 'avg', duration: { from, to, unit: 'days' } }` parses: `DatasetMeasureDurationSchema` (dataset.zod.ts 276–311) takes `from` / `to` as bare base-column names and `unit` ∈ seconds/minutes/hours/days; `DatasetMeasureSchema`'s refinement (488–523) requires `aggregate` ∈ avg/min/max/sum and refuses `field` beside `duration`. `from` / `to` must be `datetime`: `DATASET_DURATION_FIELD_TYPE = 'datetime'` (247) — "A `date` is a calendar day and a `time` a wall clock, so neither is a point a duration is measured from" — judged at `os validate` by `validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` (`measure-duration-field-type-refused`, 258) and at compile (`400 DATASET_INVALID`). So the Leave-days parenthetical "(`date` fields: no `duration`)" is **true**, and the escalation advice for that case is correctly left standing. Right. Nit: the Level A table row now reads "measures `count/sum/avg/min/max/count_distinct`, `duration`" — `duration` is a measure *kind* that takes one of avg/min/max/sum, not a seventh aggregate; the bullet below shows the real shape, so no author is misled, but the row reads as if `aggregate: 'duration'` existed.
- *Copy holes* (`rules/actions.md` new bullet, line 22). Roots per key exactly as `action-copy-template.ts` declares: `confirmText` → `record` (`actionConfirmTemplateRoots`; a registered action's `params` is always the input list, which binds nothing, so `record` alone is right for this file's subject), `successMessage` → `result` + `record` (`ACTION_SUCCESS_TEMPLATE_ROOTS`), `errorMessage` → none (`ACTION_ERROR_TEMPLATE_ROOTS = []`). Bulk: the `count` hole then each param by bare name (`bulkConfirmTemplateRoots`, bulk-action.zod.ts 334–364; a bare `tier` hole, never `params.tier`). Refused shapes: `closedScopeTemplateRefusal` (flow-text-slot-template.ts 653–) refuses `${…}` tokens, single-brace tokens and holes over unbound roots; the module note lists a blank sentence and a hole holding logic or an unknown formatter as door errors. Right. "`errorMessage` takes none" is true on BOTH surfaces (registered action: an `I18nLabel`, action.zod.ts 1424, shown as written; page row: a template slot with zero roots). The only hedge: on a *registered* action `errorMessage` is not a template slot at all (`validate-action-copy-templates.ts` `ACTION_KEYS = ['confirmText','successMessage']`), so a `${…}` or blank there is shown raw rather than refused — the bullet's last sentence does not bind the refusals to `errorMessage`, so it teaches nothing false; a reader who writes a hole into `errorMessage` is told it "takes none" either way. The toast `'Lead … reassigned.'` with a double-brace `record.name` hole — `record` is a bound root; the judge reads the root only (`pathRoot`), never the member, so `.name` is legal as written. Right.
- *`onSuccess`* (`rules/actions.md` flow example + heading). The key exists on `type: 'flow'` (`ON_SUCCESS_EXECUTORS = api / script / flow`, action-on-success-executor.ts 75) and is refused on `type: 'url'` (action.zod.ts 2085–2090). "hops once the run completes, not when it pauses at a screen" — the executor module and `flowResponse.ts` 182–193 / 636–645: only the `done` arm completes the action; `paused` and `refused` are marked `handedOff` by `judgeFlowLaunch` and the runner performs no hop for them, "neither when the surface opens nor when the flow runner later finishes the run". The reader of `${result.output.NAME}` is the console's `ActionRunner.handlePostExecution` → `navigateOnSuccess` (objectui `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` ~1989, recorded by symbol in `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` row `onSuccess.navigate`); `output` carries the flow's `isOutput` variables (action.zod.ts 1713–1720, 1796). The template `'/apps/crm/opportunity/record/${result.output.opportunity_id}'` opens with `/`, an in-app path the scheme set admits. The example targets `lead_conversion`, a flow the skill never defines; the heading now states the variable must be `isOutput`, so the example is self-consistent as written. The dev's citation of `examples/app-crm/src/flows/convert-lead.flow.ts:47` (`opportunity_id`, `type: 'text'`, `isOutput: true`) is evidence for the SHAPE, not for the example's named flow — that file's flow is `crm_convert_lead_wizard`. Right, with the ③ note below on screen flows.

**(b) The cuts — every one a restatement with a surviving home; no rule lost.**

- `actions.md` "author-controlled": trivial. `ActionRunner.executeUrl` priority sentence: an implementation note; the author-facing rule in the same paragraph ("`openIn: 'self'` forces in-place navigation; omit it and external/absolute URLs open in a new tab while relative URLs navigate in place") survives. `// zero-roundtrip; endpoint self-auths`: the prose two lines up still says "with no server round-trip … the target endpoint must enforce its own auth". "validated today, rendered once the console's print rendering ships": `rules/pages.md` § Print pages lines 94–95 on the head carry it verbatim in substance — "Validated today; the console's print rendering that applies it follows, so `os validate` warns the layout is not yet applied." Params-callout remedy → "Use one of the two mechanisms above": the section opens "There are **two** mechanisms here" with exactly two `###` subsections, so the pointer is unambiguous. "so it matches hooks and seed data with zero relearning": the paragraph's closing sentence "Same two isolation axes, same blessed name, same `undefined` cases as hooks" and the code comment "identical to the hook surface" keep the hooks parity; the words "seed data" are the only thing gone — trivial.
- `dashboards.md` ADR-0021 four-line widget comment: § Dataset-Bound Widgets (33–45) states "bind a `dataset` and select named `dimensions` + `values`", "the dataset owns the base object, allowed joins, intrinsic filter, dimensions, and certified measures", and "A widget's presentation-scope `filter` flows into the query as the runtime filter"; the "Guides → Analytics Datasets" pointer survives at line 294 and the report example's comment (388–389) restates the by-name binding for `opportunity_metrics`. All three clauses survive.
- `list-views.md` 「Field type therefore decides only in the second row … Judge every entry against the object's allowed set, never the type list」: this IS a rule, and its home is the table immediately above it, which the surviving sentence calls "the whole rule" — row 1 "**that list, verbatim** — whatever the field types are" is the "never the type list" clause, row 2 is the one place the type list applies, and the second table below ("a real column outside the allowed set → `searchable-field-unsearchable` / `400 INVALID_FIELD`") carries the refusal; `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` § Search Fields adds "declare it to pin the set explicitly. Views may narrow it, never widen it." Trivially derivable; the lost words are the worked instance "a lookup in it is scanned". Acceptable under ruling A. The related-record prescription: objectstack-data § Search Fields on the head carries all three — the stored mirror field (with the `project_name` example), the two hooks (`beforeInsert`/`beforeUpdate` on the child, `afterUpdate` on the parent, as a table), and why a `formula` cannot be the mirror (virtual, nothing to scan, `searchable-field-unsearchable`); the dotted-path refusal stays in this file's own table row (`account_id.name` → `searchable-field-unknown` / 400). Nothing lost.
- `SKILL.md` and `references/_index.md` reference none of the cut lines (read on the head; `git diff --stat 756220c4 17b18cde` on both is empty). Line 1 of `SKILL.md` untouched.

**(c) Ratchet rows — pinned at the measurement; the ruling quoted where the script requires.** The measure is `Math.ceil(Buffer.byteLength(text,'utf8') / 4)` (script line 763; no tokenizer; the SKILL.md stamp exclusion does not touch these five files). Probe over the `git show` blobs: `rules/actions.md` 8404 → 8602 bytes = 2101 → **2151**; `rules/dashboards.md` 25001 → 24956 = 6251 → **6239**; `rules/list-views.md` 12530 → 12515 = 3133 → **3129**; `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` 6017 → 7154 = 1505 → **1789**; `evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` 4915 → 5389 = 1229 → **1348**. The five new rows are exactly these counts: zero headroom on every row, no headroom smuggled in, and the two LOWERED rows (6252 → 6239, 3141 → 3129) sit exactly at the measurement. Arithmetic: ceilings +43 −13 −12 +284 +119 = **+421**; bundle growth +50 −12 −4 +284 +119 = **+437**, the 16-token difference being the pre-existing headroom (7 + 1 + 8) absorbed — consistent with the body. The raise rule (header 127–129): "Going the other way lands only in a PR whose body quotes a maintainer ruling authorizing it" — the PR body quotes 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 with the card title, the tap time and the option's own text; each raised row's comment quotes it too, the precedent rows' shape (no row-comment rule exists in the script; the self-test case 'the raise is bound to a quoted maintainer ruling' (1283) pins the REMEDY TEXT, not the rows). No lint caps line length in `scripts/**`; `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`'s 400-char SHRINK-testimony window is the block ABOVE the `CEILINGS` doc comment, which the diff does not touch. Line counts, probe: 206 → 203, 465 → 464, 303 → 311, 65 → 85, 77 → 87; package (`SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`) 2053 → 2057 lines and 28253 → 28287 tokens; whole `skills/objectstack-ui/` tree 2226 → 2260 lines — every figure in the body's table reproduces. The bundle total 206107 → 206544 is the script's own sum and is not reproduced here (its delta +437 is).

**(d) Evals.** Both files parse (`skill_name` / `evals[]`, the existing shape); ids 1–8 unique and sequential in each. views 7: `must_contain` ["grouping", "orderBy: 'period_start'"], `must_not_contain` ["orderBy: 'stage'"] — consistent with the expected output and with the refusal of a select. views 8: `must_contain` [the double-brace opener, "onSuccess", "result.output"], `must_not_contain` ["${record.name}"] — a plain JSON string; no runner in the repo reads `assertions` (the only `must_contain` readers are the two evals READMEs), so neither the double-brace opener nor `${` meets an interpreter. analytics 8: `must_contain` ["duration", "unit: 'days'"], `must_not_contain` ["beforeUpdate"] — right. The card-specific pair is present: "group opportunities by stage in pipeline order" = views 7, "Lead NAME reassigned toast" = views 8. `evals/README.md` describes the files generically and counts nothing; no index needs updating.

**(e) Wanted lines met, nothing beyond.** `list-views.md`: grouping + `orderBy` ✓ (plus the TOC entry; `#grouping` is a unique heading). `dashboards.md:69-72`: the measure named in the table row and the Computed-column bullet, with the escalation advice corrected in place for the `datetime` case and the Leave-days case kept with its reason ✓. `actions.md:20-21`: holes, roots, bulk `count`, params, refused shapes ✓. `actions.md:64-69`: `onSuccess` reading `${result.output.VAR}` ✓. Six files, all inside the claim + amendment surface; the script diff touches only the five rows and their comments (no logic, no other row). `SKILL.md` line 1 untouched ✓.

**(f) PR body.** Line 1 is the harness attribution HTML comment, line 2 the harness `_Requested by_` line, line 3 `Fixes #26295`, lines 4–5 `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`, line-initial. os-dev.md 323 on the head: 「例外:harness 自写的 PR 正文首行归属注释原样留、只报;`Fixes #N` 紧随其后;dev 自写仍禁」(the rule spells the number as a placeholder) — the exemption exists; whether the `_Requested by_` line is part of the harness block I cannot read, and the dev reports it as the harness's two-line block (deviation 1). No parser requires line 1: `clause2-line.mjs` reads the first line-initial declaration, `record-recognisers` `deliveredCardNumber` reads the body, and the three closing/claim guards on the head are success. 维护者速读: six labels in order ✓; 需要你做的 = exactly one action, Approve ✓ (Tier H); 先看 = 3 files naming the risky hunks ✓; 两分钟验证 = one command with the expected sight — the script prints `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: PATH is N tokens (ceiling C; headroom H).` per file (line 926), so "headroom 都是 0" is what it prints ✓. English sections What changes / Tests / Acceptance notes / Verification with readings folded into details blocks ✓. Both readings (whole-file and whole-package before/after, lines and tokens) present and reproduced above ✓. Blemish: the Verification line reads "on head {HEAD}" — an unfilled placeholder (cosmetic; the head is named in the report and on the PR).

**(g) Report.** os-dev-report 6431647940 at 2026-10-27T01:43Z: `deviations` (7), `line_budget`, `out_of_scope_findings` (3) present as the order asked; `files_changed` / `rules_retired` absent — and NOT in the os-dev.md JSON template on the head (its keys: issue, status, branch, pr, session, premise_still_valid, summary, tests, gates, dogfood_battery, mcp_calls, api_writes, open_questions, out_of_scope_findings), so nothing is missing. Branch `claude/project-thread-5txv5f` = the claim's branch ✓. `mcp_calls: 0`, `api_writes: 2` (relay `pr_create`, the report comment) ✓. The PR's assignee `os-warren` and label `skip-changeset` were written by the relay at `pr_create` (the PR is authored by objectstack-fleet[bot]; `documentation` and `size/m` are the labeler's). Commit trailers: the model-free pair; no model name in the commit or the PR body.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right. `skills/objectstack-ui/` carries no `package.json` (its 11 files on the head: `SKILL.md`, `evals/*`, `references/*`, `rules/*`), so no npm package's `files[]` moves; `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is repo tooling. `Check Changeset` on the head: success. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial on the PR body (lines 4–5) and match the claim.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Base reconciled.** The branch forks from `756220c4` (the body's "base 756220c4"); the PR's recorded base `e931621a` is `main`'s tip at creation (one commit later, `ci(sdui)`); `origin/main` is now `2163e806` (`seedFile`). `git diff --stat 756220c4 origin/main` over the scope paths touches only `.github/workflows/lint.yml` (a comment block) and `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md` (generated, +1): no file of this PR moved on `main`; no rebase is owed.
2. **The dev's note 1** (orders price lines, the gate prices tokens): a 收班简报 note for the seat, already carried by ruling A for all eight audit cards — not a card.
3. **The dev's note 2** (`errorMessage` is an `I18nLabel` on a registered action, a template slot on a page row): verified by reading (action.zod.ts 1424; validate-action-copy-templates.ts 54–58). The teaching is true on both surfaces; nothing to file.
4. **The dev's note 3** (`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` places the two declaration lines under `## Verification`, os-dev.md puts them line-initial after `Fixes`): verified — the template (756220c4) has `Fixes #`, What changes / Why / Verification, then the two lines, then a Human Minimum checklist; both parsers read line-initial lines anywhere, so one placement satisfies both. A 收班简报 note (the two texts could name one order); not a card.
5. **Screen flows and the `onSuccess` example** — a note for the seat's 席位核对, not a defect in the spec reading: the executor module and `judgeFlowLaunch` say a run that pauses at its first screen is handed off and the runner never hops for it, so `onSuccess` beside a `type: 'flow'` action is live only for a flow whose run COMPLETES at launch (an autolaunched flow, or one that reaches `end` without a screen). The example's old parenthetical "(delegates to a screen flow)" was replaced by the new heading, which states the rule correctly; `examples/app-crm`'s convert flow is a `type: 'screen'` wizard whose `opportunity_id` is bound by a screen step, so an author who pairs this example with THAT flow gets an inert hop. No lint judges `onSuccess` against the target flow's type (0 hits in `packages/lint/src`). One word in the heading ("a flow that completes, e.g. autolaunched") would close it; optional, costs tokens on a row now at zero headroom.
6. **`SKILL.md` line 146** lists the list-views topics ("filtering, `userFilters`, toolbar search, sorting, kanban, gantt") without "grouping" — optional; `SKILL.md` is a ratchet row of its own and the order's surface excluded its line 1 only.
7. **Lane mapping in the brief** was stale: the ratchet, its self-test, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:skill-docs` and `check:skill-refs` run in `Type Check · source gates`; `check:skill-examples` in `Type Check · consumer gates` (lint.yml on `origin/main`). Both success on the head, so the verdicts stand.

## 维护者速读
改了什么:objectstack-ui 技能包补上 18.2 的四条教学——列表 `grouping.fields[]` 与 `orderBy`、数据集 `duration` 度量、动作文案的 `{{ }}` 占位(各键的根、bulk 的 `count`、四种拒收形态)、flow 动作的 `onSuccess` 读 `${result.output.NAME}`;配三条 eval。按你的裁决 A:先在同文件删重复(三处共 −300 token,去处都点了名),余额按实测改棘轮里该包五行的天花板(两行反而降了)。
为什么改:AI 作者在 18.2 上按阶段分组列表、算平均成交时长、写带记录名的 toast、流程跑完后跳到新建记录,技能一条都没教(审计 #26184 的 U1/U2/U4/U5 行);`${record.name}` 写进 toast 会在 `os validate` 被拒。
风险与回滚:只改技能 markdown、eval JSON 和棘轮五行数字;不发版、无运行时改动;回滚 = revert 本 PR。风险在教学措辞是否属实——复核员逐句对着 spec 源码核过(见下),三条新示例也经 zod 解析探针。
先看:① `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 文案占位一行与 flow 示例的 `onSuccess`;② `rules/list-views.md` 新 Grouping 节(select 按选项顺序、`orderBy` 只接数字/日期/布尔);③ `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 五行(+43 / −13 / −12 / +284 / +119,每行钉在实测值上)。
两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 预期全绿,objectstack-ui 的 actions / dashboards / list-views 与两个 eval 文件各印 `headroom 0`。
需要你做的:Approve(Tier H,`skills/**` 是发布面);席位随后落地。
席位意见:同意落地。两处可选的后续(不挡本 PR):flow 示例的 `onSuccess` 只在运行一次跑完的 flow 上生效,屏幕流目标会是一次空跳,标题加一个词即可;SKILL.md L146 列表视图的主题列表还没写 grouping。

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-27T01:59Z — seat review of record for #26295 on head `17b18cde`, against GitHub, not the report's own account. Published surface `skills/**` ⇒ Tier H (`check-governed-merges --pr 26385`: `skills/objectstack-ui/**` ×5 on the register, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` off it, 137 changed lines): the record of this tier is the independent `## Contract review` at comment 6431836359 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `17b18cde`, `VERDICT: PASS`, one declared probe — `wc -c` over `git show` blobs to recompute the ratchet's measure; drafted by a reviewer other than the implementer, the card thread's dev). This seat adds the landing read; the landing itself waits for a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval — ⛔ the seat does not ready, arm or enqueue a Tier H PR.
